grammar: English Singsing This is my family

read: My family is like a team.
I call them my family squad!
My mother wakes up early to make breakfast for us.
My father goes to work and plays with me at home.
I have a big brother named Tom.
My little sister Emma draws pictures.
When we work together, everything is fun.
Our home is full of happiness.
dictation: My family is like a team.
My mother wakes up early to make breakfast for us.
My father goes to work and plays with me at home.
My brother Tom helps me with homework.
When we work together, everything is fun.
Our home is full of happiness.
vocab: family - a group of people who live together and love each other
mother - the female parent who takes care of children
father - the male parent who protects and helps the family
brother - a boy who shares the same parents
sister - a girl who shares the same parents
team - a group of people working together
leader - someone who guides and makes plans
helper - someone who supports and assists others
love - a strong feeling of caring for someone
home - the place where a family lives together
